text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho-saaan! Could you please move 
over here~?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
? The staff are going out of their way to 
talk to that girl... Is she someone 
important?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's just a little kid, so maybe 
she's being a bit selfish? Her running was 
great though, so she seems promising.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I see. Hey, you! Make sure you listen to 
what grownups tell you, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Shut up! Shut up, shut up, shut uuup!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the explanation! Sweep, 
Trainer! Please make sure you're strictly 
on time for the concert!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer! Please, only Trainer must 
remain behind!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"We've heard about what happened the other 
day as well, and, um..."

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Shall I come to the waiting room 20 
minutes before? I can call for extra hands 
if needed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What came to mind back then was my 
conversation with Sweep Tosho's 
grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the more someone worries about 
you, the more it makes you wonder if they 
just don't trust you, don't you think?”

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Besides, the staff who worked on 
Sweep-san's debut have been worried about 
her the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
They said Sweep-san can be terribly 
selfish. That she might even suddenly skip 
out on the Winning Live—

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Wouldn't it give us more 
peace of mind if we started making our 
move early, factoring in a buffer just in 
case?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
“...... Understood. If you go that far, 
Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, the Hanshin JF Winning Live 
stage began. Sweep Tosho made it onto the 
stage without being late, and—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She firmly accomplished what she set out 
to do.
